source.title: The War Within Hotfixes for September 10, 2024
source.author: perculia

quote: Added a Shatter recipe to Khaz Algar Enchanting
notes: Blizzard hotfix text reproduced by Wowhead. This adds a new Gleaming Shard to Storm Dust conversion; the source does not give output count or conversion probability. It states shard quality caps dust quality, with skill and Uncommon Utilitarian determining resulting quality.
affects: Khaz Algar Enchanting: Gleaming Shard -> Storm Dust shatter conversion
wording: Added a Shatter recipe to Khaz Algar Enchanting, allowing you to turn Gleaming Shards into Storm Dust.

source.title: The War Within Hotfixes - October 16 (October 7 entry)
source.author: Blizzard Entertainment

quote: Gear purchased from Renown quartermasters can no longer be disenchanted.
notes: Official Blizzard hotfix, October 7 entry. Applies to gear purchased from Renown quartermasters, not to all gear with a Renown requirement or all world-drop gear. No individual item IDs specified.
affects: Gear purchased from Renown quartermasters in The War Within
wording: Gear purchased from Renown quartermasters can no longer be disenchanted.
